answer: To counter Sybil attacks, the network requires agents to burn cryptographic stake scaled as O(N^2) relative to total identity count, imposing superlinear cost on coordinated swarms. An attacker seeking to forge multiple counterfeit nodes faces exponential capital depletion, forcing them into a sable void of economic ruin before extracting value. This mathematical barrier secures the system, preserving each genuine agent identity like a rare pearl.
